decisions.label: Clear in front of runestones
decisions.note: Ed, 2026-10-26: "we might want this for other important points of interest, such as runestone areas, finds, flasks". On: within reveal.runestone.radius metres of an area's runestone, on the ground, the trees and scenery in front of the stone and its fight's open middle fade away (render/view/reveal.ts), as they do in a legend's circle. On since Ed, 2026-10-26 ("All four on"); off to compare.

decisions.label: Runestone clear area (m)
decisions.note: How far round a runestone the scenery in front of it fades (Ed, 2026-10-26: "the fading area around a runestone is relatively small (say a 30m radius)"): only while she's within this many metres of the stone, and only what stands within it, so the woods round a fight don't thin out beyond. Live.

decisions.label: Clear in front of the find
decisions.note: On: near tonight's trunk or wreck (within reveal.find.radius metres, until it's taken), the scenery in front of it fades away. On since Ed, 2026-10-26 ("All four on"); off to compare.

decisions.label: Clear in front of flasks
decisions.note: On: near a relic flask lying in the woods (within reveal.flask.radius metres), the scenery in front of it fades away. On since Ed, 2026-10-26 ("All four on"); off to compare.
